name: 20469-longprefill-qwen35-08b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B, bf16. Public and ungated, ~1.6 GiB; not in this machine's HF cache, so it downloads once on first start.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 of an a3 node. SM90 is required and not merely adequate: the flashinfer linear-attention prefill kernel refuses SM100+, so a Blackwell card cannot run this configuration at all.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 512 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. 384 requests are measured.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no shared prefix: 16384 prompt tokens (stdev 0) against exactly 8 output tokens (stdev 0), with ignore_eos true and temperature 0.0.
purpose: A document analysis assistant returning brief verdicts on 16-thousand-token submissions, four concurrent users, one compact model, single GPU.
launch:
# The engine's launch line: sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id`.
# Flat `key: value` only -- nested blocks are dropped, and environment variables cannot live
# here. A bool is a FLAG: `true` emits `--key`, `false` emits nothing.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B
tp-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
mem-fraction-static: 0.88
trust-remote-code: true
disable-radix-cache: true
chunked-prefill-size: -1
max-prefill-tokens: 32768
context-length: 32768
attention-backend: fa3
linear-attn-backend: flashinfer

# EXPECT A LONG FIRST START: inductor compiles at a 32768-token capture ceiling, once, before
# /health answers.
enforce-piecewise-cuda-graph: true
piecewise-cuda-graph-compiler: inductor
piecewise-cuda-graph-max-tokens: 32768
